flash_691361.description:

flash_691363.description:
IDF troops are searching Kibbutz Zikim in the Gaza border area after a breach was discovered in the community's perimeter fence. According to security sources, there is no indication of an infiltration from the Gaza Strip at this stage.

The IDF Spokesperson's Unit stated, "A short time ago, forces were summoned to Kibbutz Zikim following a report from the community’s security coordinator regarding a cut discovered in the fence. Upon arrival, troops initiated a sweep of the area. As of now, no suspects have been identified, and it cannot be determined when the breach was made. IDF forces are continuing their search to rule out any security incidents."

(Arutz Sheva-Israel National News' North American desk is keeping you updated until the start of Shabbat in New York. The time posted automatically on all Israel National News articles, however, is Israeli time.)

flash_629916.description:
Arutz Sheva-Israel National News is stopping its round-the-clock news updates at this time in honor of the start of Shabbat in North America, where they are being written now.

Updates will resume Saturday night from Israel, following the conclusion of Shabbat at 20:09 Jerusalem time.

Shabbat Shalom!

flash_691385.description:
Firefighters fully brought a blaze under control overnight at a subterranean construction site for the future BIG commercial complex in Petah Tikva, following hours of intensive firefighting efforts.

Fire and Rescue Services reported that all seats of the fire in the underground parking facility, which spans approximately 2,000 square meters, have been completely extinguished. Following the incident, Central District Fire Commander, Fire Commissioner Roni Kedem, ordered the establishment of a special task force to investigate the cause of the fire.

F-16 fighter jets were scrambled toward the aircraft and escorted them out of the restricted airspace.

Magen David Adom (MDA) paramedics treated him at the scene and evacuated him to Beilinson Hospital in Petah Tikva.

flash_691447.description:
The chairman of the "Together" party, Naftali Bennett, responded to remarks made by MK Moshe Gafni, who announced that he would no longer commit in advance to automatically backing Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu.

"Make no mistake - Gafni, Bibi, and Deri are one and the same," Bennett said. He added that "anyone who truly wants to draft haredim and support IDF soldiers knows that they must keep the architects of draft evasion, Deri and Gafni, out of the government."

Magen David Adom (MDA) paramedics treated him at the scene and evacuated him to Sheba Hospital in Tel Hashomer.

Earlier, the Houthis claimed responsibility for the incident, alleging the operation targeted weapons depots and Saudi military troop concentrations.

According to Israel Railways, the system is designed to enable an increase in train frequency using the existing rail infrastructure, while improving safety and the management of train traffic.
